dominant_strengths: Painterly impressionist backdrop framing a dark IDE panel creates unusual emotional warmth uncommon in devtools marketing pages
Task list typography is clean and hierarchical, with subtle diff colors (+135/-21) reinforcing developer authenticity
Logo wall uses consistent monochrome treatment, letting brand recognition carry without visual noise
dominant_weaknesses: The painted landscape clashes tonally with the strict monospace IDE chrome; juxtaposition feels decorative rather than conceptually linked
Center column between task list and Trigger/View Behavior text is awkwardly empty, breaking spatial rhythm of the composer panel
Plan composer input sits low and disconnected; the task checklist and details panel lack a unifying grid or alignment spine
fix_priorities: Tighten the three-column composer grid—fill or collapse the empty middle pane and align task headers with detail headers
Justify the painterly background conceptually (e.g., subtle generative tie-in) or reduce its contrast so it recedes behind the UI
Strengthen vertical rhythm between Trigger/View Behavior/Tasks sections with consistent spacing tokens
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral pull from the painting-meets-terminal contrast, decent reflective storytelling about an AI planner, but behavioral clarity suffers from the unresolved middle column.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as a credible Cursor devtools hero showcasing planning/agent workflows, though the scroll section feels more atmospheric than functionally explanatory.
